title: Hardware Procurement: One Quote, One Order
content:
**Rule.** A client may hold any number of Hardware Procurement orders. Each quote covers one product line at one quantity and becomes its own order, with its own price, deposit, delivery, return window and invoices.

**What follows from the rule**

- There is no limit on how many hardware orders one client may hold at the same time.
- Two product lines are never combined on one quote. A client buying laptops and docking stations receives one quote for each, and each becomes a separate order.
- Because every order carries its own deposit, delivery, return window and invoices, a figure on one order (its price, its deposit invoice, its return window) never transfers to another order of the same client.

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| How many hardware orders may one client hold? | Any number; no limit applies. |
| How many product lines may one quote cover? | One, at one quantity. |
| Does an order share its deposit or invoices with another order? | No; each order has its own. |
